payback.heading: What this station returns
payback.illustrative: Illustrative scenario — not a personalised forecast
payback.energyAssumptions: Assumes 900–1,200 kWh per kW each year, with {share}% of generation used on site. This is a scenario range, not a roof survey. No income from exported energy is included.
payback.missingConsumption: No consumption entered — savings are not capped to your use.
payback.consumptionCap: Savings are capped at {monthly} kWh × 12 months. Seasonal and hourly differences still require a load profile.
payback.gridCosts: Cost basis: grid-tied catalogue equipment plus the listed installation range, scaled per kW. No batteries included.
payback.hybridCosts: Cost basis: hybrid catalogue kits, including their listed batteries, plus installation, scaled per kW. This does not size a battery for your home.
payback.exampleCosts: The reference prices are demo figures. This payback range is illustrative until real equipment and installation costs are confirmed.
payback.exclusions: Simple payback excludes maintenance, battery replacement, degradation, financing and tariff changes. A site visit and confirmed quote are needed before making a purchase decision.
payback.noPayback: A payback range needs matching installed-cost data and positive savings. These inputs do not provide both.
payback.backupOnly: Backup-only storage does not generate solar energy. Its value is outage protection; no solar payback is calculated.
payback.invalidInputs: Enter positive power and tariff values and a self-consumption share from 0 to 100% to see a scenario.

Legal.privacyDescription: What personal data the INVICSOL website collects, why, for how long, and what rights a visitor has.
Legal.privacyIntro: This document explains how INVICSOL (“we”) handles the personal data of visitors to {domain}. Processing follows the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”. By submitting any form on this site you confirm that you have read this policy.

privacySections.title: Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: The data controller is INVICSOL, Lviv, Ukraine. For anything concerning your data, write to {email} — we reply within 10 working days.

privacySections.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what you enter into the site's forms yourself, plus the minimum of technical data needed for the site to run.
items: Form data: name, phone number, message text, and the chosen station or property parameters if you used the calculator.
Reviews: the name, rating and text you leave on a station page. They are published after moderation.
Technical data: the IP address in server logs — used only for spam protection and kept for a short time.
A cookie holding your chosen site language. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.

privacySections.title: Why we need it
paragraphs: To answer your enquiry, prepare a quote, call you back at a convenient time and, if you asked, reach you via Telegram or Viber. The legal basis is the consent you give by submitting the form. The data is not used for mailings and is not passed to advertising networks.

privacySections.title: Analytics
paragraphs: To understand traffic we may use Plausible Analytics — a cookie-free service that collects no personal data and cannot identify an individual visitor.

privacySections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: Data is stored on the servers of our hosting and database provider, which processes it solely on our instructions. If you choose to contact us through a messenger, the message passes through that service (Telegram, Viber) under its own terms. We never sell personal data and never pass it to third parties for their own purposes, except where the law expressly requires.

privacySections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiry data is kept while your enquiry is being handled and for no longer than 3 years after it is closed, then deleted. On request we delete it sooner.

privacySections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Ukrainian law you have the right to:
items: know which of your data we process and receive a copy of it;
have data deleted when there is no lawful ground to keep it;
lodge a complaint with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights.
privacySections.after: To exercise any of these rights, write to {email}.

privacySections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this document. The date of the current version is shown at the top of the page; material changes are flagged separately.
